topology.stage_1: claim type, modality, applicability scope, and finite node referent seeds
topology.stage_2: bound-node grounding and non-anchor source membership, plus relation argument tuples conditional on active nodes and distinct anchors
topology.stage_3: only active-relation kind, grounding, and source membership

bounded_surface.node_referent_handle: anchor_span_id::role; NONE is inactive; __unresolved__ is applicable but insufficiently distinguished
bounded_surface.node_handle_collision_policy: If multiple source-supported referents remain for one anchor and role, select __unresolved__; never collapse them into one node
bounded_surface.bound_node_grounding: The selected anchor is included by construction; an active node cannot have zero source spans
bounded_surface.relation_argument_policy: Finite tuples contain active nodes only, no duplicate argument, and distinct anchors for binary tuples
bounded_surface.inactive_dependent_policy: omit questions; omission is N/A and is distinct from applicable __unresolved__
bounded_surface.scope_semantics: Scope is a restriction on applicability or domain of the represented claim. Historical provenance, citation or date mention, background description, evidential support, and comparison provenance do not by themselves count as scope.
bounded_surface.unresolved_policy: Any applicable required __unresolved__ causes DecisionUnresolved and bundle EXTRACTION_ABSTAIN; no candidate, ClaimIR, or RESIDUAL
bounded_surface.compiler_policy: Only derive deterministic fields, prune impossible choices, and omit inactive questions; never guess unresolved, change selected answers, repair invalid tuples, or synthesize another claim

conditions.s2: explicit condition under which claim applies
